dish_inference_profiles.rationale: A rice-led opening course is likely designed as a calm foundation with low heaviness, restrained savoriness, and a gentle grain sweetness rather than a strong first punch.
uncertainty_notes: The menu image only gives the title, so the exact rice cultivar, garnish, and preparation are not public

dish_inference_profiles.rationale: Bugak generally introduces crisp texture, restrained salinity, and a short savory finish, making it suitable as a small opening texture contrast.
uncertainty_notes: The exact ingredient used for the bugak is not specified on the menu image

dish_inference_profiles.rationale: Deodeok usually brings aromatic bitterness and a clean earthy line, so it is modeled as a root-focused course with higher aroma than richness.
uncertainty_notes: Preparation style, seasoning, and whether smoke is involved are not visible on the menu

dish_inference_profiles.rationale: A bomdong course likely works as a clean leafy interlude with freshness and slight bitterness rather than a dense savory moment.
uncertainty_notes: The image marks this as a +75,000 supplement, and the supporting components are not public

dish_inference_profiles.rationale: Minari-centered dishes usually read as highly aromatic, green, and cleansing, so the profile emphasizes brightness and clean finish over weight.
uncertainty_notes: The menu only provides the title, so dressing, protein pairing, and temperature remain unknown

dish_inference_profiles.rationale: A jorim course strongly suggests concentrated braised savory flavor with moderate salinity and a longer sauce-driven finish than the earlier vegetable courses.
uncertainty_notes: Fish species, broth base, and sweetness level of the jorim are not public

dish_inference_profiles.rationale: Samgyetang in a fine-dining lunch sequence likely acts as a warm restorative pivot with poultry umami, herbal lift, and more comfort than heaviness.
uncertainty_notes: The exact deconstruction level, stock concentration, and ginseng prominence are not listed on the image
